selection: Sort accepted reported durations within year and recorded gender; retain exactly N captures, splitting boundary ties by original CSV record order. Identical rows remain separate.
comparison: Median of fastest N versus median of all remaining accepted captures in the same recorded gender; separate study for N=20 and N=50.
weather: Retain parent fixed 09:00–15:00 Europe/Berlin median temperature. No duration-derived exposure.
measure: Pearson r and every single-edition omission; equal edition weights.
limitations: Groups are defined by the observed outcome, not verified elite/training status or pre-race ability. Different people and field strength each year. Fixed six-hour context can poorly represent conditions experienced by faster runners. Correlations do not measure causal heat sensitivity.
